text:
Maya P.: Quick heads up — saw a billing delta on cust cohort 'beta-ab-2' after the pricing toggle yesterday. Invoices for April exported to S3 show ~12% higher usage charges than expected. Anyone else seeing this? @Samir K. @Ellie Chen
Samir K.: On it. Which invoice file? path?
Maya P.: s3://redwood-billing/exports/2026-04/ab-toggle/beta-ab-2-invoices.csv — I pulled reconciliation id #4672 and there's line items with both old_rate_id and new_rate_id for same usage. Looks like some tokens got billed at both tiers.
BillingBot: Automated alert: export-processing completed (job 4672). No schema errors. Checksums match.
Ellie Chen: That dual-rate symptom sounds like an overlap during rollout window. Did the grandfathering flag run? @Tony Alvarez handled the rollout.
Tony Alvarez: I can confirm the toggle was gradual 00:00-01:20 UTC yesterday. We used canary 10% -> 30% -> 100% with backend gating. I didn't expect double-billing. Paging infra-log: any retries causing duplicated record ingestion?
Samir K.: Give me 10m. I'll run a quick query across billing_events: ```SELECT customer_id, usage_ts, count(*) FROM billing_events WHERE customer_id='beta-ab-2' AND usage_ts BETWEEN '2026-04-01' AND '2026-04-02' GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING count(*)>1;```
Maya P.: If duplicates are present, we might need to issue credits rather than reprocess invoices. Need approval path.
Samir K.: Query shows ~18k duplicate rows for 234 customer_ids; duplicates cluster around 00:45-00:55 UTC. Looks like a routing fallback triggered a replay.
Tony Alvarez: Yep, routing fallback to legacy pricing path when model pool transiently reported 503s. The request broker retried with 'idempotency-key' missing on some retries. We're patching to enforce idempotency header on retries.
Ellie Chen: Action items: (1) Tony patch + redeploy to ensure idempotency header; (2) Samir produce a draft credit spreadsheet with credit amounts for affected invoices; (3) Finance sign-off flow for credits — who OKs? @Maya P.
Maya P.: I'll approve credits up to $5k per customer. Anything above goes to finance director. Samir, include per-customer calc and example invoice lines. Also notify customers with a standard message.
Samir K.: Working on spreadsheet. For transparency, propose message: 'We've identified duplicate billing for usage during a pricing toggle; we've issued a credit equivalent to duplicated charges. No action required.' Want legal to review? @Tony
Tony Alvarez: Legal review optional for < $10k aggregate per-cust. I'll loop in legal if any disputes pop.
BillingBot: Task created: FIN-CREDIT-1127 assigned to Samir K., due 2026-04-07.
Maya P.: :thumbsup: Let's also add a postmortem in eng-runtime and a canary rule: do not switch pricing path within rolling window of 5m. Tony please add to rollout playbook.
